harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 (RHEL 10) via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf using both `blacklist` and `install .../bin/false` directives, rebuilt the initramfs with dracut so the block applies at early boot, and verified modprobe refuses to load the module both before and after a full node reboot (with confirmed boot_id change proving the restart).
actions_performed: Captured baseline: boot_id 7223d5b7..., usb_storage not loaded, no blacklist config present
Confirmed module was not loaded (no unload needed) and modprobe usb-storage is blocked immediately after config change
Rebuilt initramfs with 'dracut -f' and confirmed via lsinitrd that the blacklist config file is embedded in the initramfs
Captured pre-restart baseline evidence (boot_id, blacklist file, blocked modprobe attempt)
Issued 'shutdown -r now' via sudo -n on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec became available again; confirmed new boot_id a3577cb4... and new boot time 2026-09-29 08:22, proving the restart occurred
Post-restart verification: usb_storage still not loaded, blacklist config still present, modprobe usb-storage still blocked

evidence.requirement: usb-storage module blacklisted persistently and not currently loaded (initial state)
evidence.summary: Created /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf, confirmed module not loaded, confirmed modprobe blocked, rebuilt initramfs with dracut and confirmed blacklist file embedded via lsinitrd
Captured boot_id 7223d5b7-fa56-4ff3-acee-959a5cf5f146, confirmed usb_storage not loaded, blacklist file present, modprobe usb-storage blocked
Issued sudo -n shutdown -r now in background; exec stream closed as node went down, confirming the reboot command was accepted

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Polling attempts timed out while node1 was rebooting, then succeeded with new boot_id a3577cb4-9c00-4e5f-8b68-74cc0d0a86bd and new boot time 2026-09-29 08:22, differing from the pre-restart boot_id 7223d5b7...
After reboot, usb_storage still not loaded, blacklist config file still present with both directives intact, and modprobe usb-storage attempt still blocked with the same error
